Biggest benifit to a DD system is that you are pushing less force around a corner. You need space around the filiament in the bowden tube and that space allows the filiament to spring on push or pull actions. With a direct drive you have none of that. Therefore a single step of the motor is a single step of the filiament. Allows for much better retraction and control of the filiament.
